About the platform

Science learning through conversation.

Science Adventures of Luna and Leo is designed for children in transitional kindergarten through second grade. It builds on research showing that children learn when media becomes a two-way experience instead of a one-way presentation.

Characters pause to ask questions, listen to children’s ideas, and respond in ways that encourage observation, prediction, explanation, and continued dialogue.

Platform access: This research platform is being developed and studied through the Converse to Learn initiative. Public access is not currently available.

LearnersChildren in TK–2
FocusEarly science and dialogic learning
ExperienceAI-supported conversational stories

Learning design

Young learners stay active in the story.

Talk and Respond

Children explain what they notice and receive responses connected to their ideas.

Make Predictions

Questions encourage children to anticipate what may happen and explain their reasoning.

Explore in Two Languages

The broader research examines bilingual conversational support in English and Spanish.
